integrity: All stated universal assertions have a written proof. Computational tests are finite cross-checks and are not independent auditing. No priority or independent certification is represented as established.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for positive diagonal-power maps on finitely generated free semigroups and their nonerasing endomorphisms; not all morphisms and not erasing morphisms. Closely related binary cases may follow from Honkala 2024. Literature priority risk in unindexed monoid or matrix root treatments.
title: Centralizers and iterative roots of diagonal power endomorphisms of free semigroups
